Gate THYROX_* env names and their test coverage

thyrox is the only client, so the configuration it reads carries its
own prefix, as OmniRoute reads OMNIROUTE_*. checkEnvPrefix measures
every environment read in versioned production code (TypeScript,
Python, and shell in its environment-contract forms) and every own
THYROX_* variable against the test files that name it.

The 494 inherited CLAUDE_* reads are frozen per file; the rename pays
them. A new one, an own variable without a test, or a stale baseline
entry blocks the pre-commit.

Seven own variables had no test. Each has one now, with an annulment
that drops exactly the case depending on it. Two first drafts did not
discriminate: toolchain.sh's idempotence guard made the child source a
no-op, so the cases read the inherited environment; env -i fixes it.
